turns.question: How many distinct customers bought from us in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" can mean three things here, so each is given under its own metric: Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) was 10 customers in September 2026 (1 to 30 September); Signups was 9 new customers who signed up in September 2026; Customers to date (everyone signed up by the end of the period) was 30 customers as of 30 September 2026. Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
